issues.quote: Operating income dropped to $4.0 billion in fiscal 2025 from $7.1 billion in fiscal 2024, compressing operating margin to 4.6%.
issues.problem: Internally inconsistent: $4.0B / $94.8B = 4.2%, not 4.6%. Tesla's reported FY2025 operating income was about $4.4B, which matches the 4.6% margin, so the $4.0B figure appears wrong.
(97.7-94.8)/97.7 = 2.97%, which rounds to 3.0%. Minor rounding error.

data.summary: Most figures are plausible, but the operating income ($4.0B) contradicts the stated 4.6% operating margin. The likely correct value is about $4.4B. There is also a minor rounding error on the revenue decline.
